title: Resolution to grant tax break for Manhattan affordable housing project
summary: The resolution approves a real property tax exemption for a housing project at Block 2109, Lot 17 and Block 2118, Lot 11 in Manhattan, under state law governing housing development fund companies. The exemption can last up to 40 years from the project's effective date and would end early if the property is not operated as required or sold without approval. It applies in exchange for the owner waiving other tax breaks, except certain exemptions for seniors or people with disabilities.
